name: RHEL Patching Survey
description: Parameters for the RHEL host patching job template.

spec.question_description: Host group, inventory collection, or host pattern to patch.
When enabled, only security-classified errata will be applied.
Comma-separated list of packages or glob patterns to exclude (e.g. kernel*,podman*). Leave blank for no exclusions.
Number of hosts to patch simultaneously. 0 patches all hosts in parallel.
Run dnf autoremove after patching to clean up orphaned packages.
